scope: Separate the public landing page from the existing assignment workspace

routes./: Public introduction; valid signed-in sessions go to /workspace
routes./workspace: Existing guest and account workspace, excluded from indexing
routes./product: Explicit introduction remains accessible for all visitors

compatibility: Old result and checkout-return query parameters survive temporary redirects
Old #rubric-checker links reach the localized workspace
Unexpired drafts offer a continue action without exposing content
Other-account, expired, corrupt and empty drafts do not show a resume action
Existing text and uploaded files survive navigation
Language changes preserve workspace input and result state

checks.interruption: One SaaS browser run encountered ERR_NETWORK_IO_SUSPENDED; its rerun passed

limits.serverSessionValidation: Real signature and expiry validation with a local-only fixture secret
